notes.title: 02.07.2019 - BUILD UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hellooooo citizens of Gamindustri!

We have implemented a patch to [i][b]Re;Birth1[/b][/i] that addresses these issues:
[list]
[*] An issue where the MB cap of 9999 was preventing users from accessing new DLC has been fixed.
[*] Fixes for unlocalized text errors.
[/list]

Thank you all for your patience and support! If any issues continue to persist please let us know by commenting on this thread :)

notes.title: 5.18.2018 Update
notes.notes:
Calling all players of Gamindustri! We have some great news! We have updated the build today with the following fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where playing in-game movies would cause the game to crash.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and help with this issue. If there are other problems, please continue using the forums to search for possible fixes or submit the issues to our PC Support form [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]here[/url] to give us feedback directly!

本作にに更新がありましたので、更新内容を案内いたします：
[list]
[*]ムービー再生にクラッシュが発生する不具合を修正
[/list]

本件につきましてご了承いただき誠にありがとうございます。
他に何かご質問ある場合・フォーラムをご確認または[url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]お問い合わせ先[/url]にご連絡いただけますようお願い申し上げます。

各位游汐葉界的玩家們, 我們有好消息!今天的系統更新包括以下的修改與進階: 

[list]
[*]播放遊戲裡的影片時發生故障的問題已修好了
[/list]

謝謝大家關於這個問題的幫助與耐心. 如果遇到任何別的問題的話,請在遊戲的網路論尋找解答或是在[url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]PC論壇[/url]上直接報告任何問題或反應!

notes.title: Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth1 [UPDATE 2366765]
notes.notes:
We’ve got an exciting announcement for all the players of Gamindustri! We’ve updated the build today 12/18/17 with the following new features and improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]Language Update: Addition of Traditional Chinese interface and subtitles.[/b]
[*] Adjusted volume levels for some event scenes.
[*] Fixed GUI elements falling out of place in the Dungeon Info menu.
[*] Fixed the display of text lines in event scenes.
[/list]

Thanks for your patience, and we hope you enjoy playing Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth 1! 

If you encounter any issues, please let us know at our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback directly. We will also be checking in on the forums.

超次次元遊戲戰機少女重生1 [更新2366765]

我們有個為所有GAMINDUSTRI玩家的火熾公報! 今天(12/18/17)的系統更新包括了以下的新功能跟進步:

[list]
[*] [b]語言更新: 加上繁體中文的界面和字幕[/b]
[*] 調整某些遊戲場面的音量
[*] 修改迷宮情報選單的玩著界面
[*] 修改遊戲場面的字幕顯示
[/list]

感謝您的耐心等待! 希望您會欣賞超次次元遊戲戰機少女重生1!

Have a good one!
-Orion

notes.title: Japanese language update and a new Deluxe Pack DLC!
notes.notes: A new Japanese language mode has been added to Neptunia Re;Birth1 along with a new paid DLC. This Deluxe Pack DLC contains a digital art book, soundtrack, wallpapers, and a windows theme.

notes.title: A New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow citizens of Steam! We've been working through the weekend to bring you guys another update that should fix the following issues:

[list]
[*]1080p windowed support! Note: If you have your in-game video settings set to Fullscreen Mode, the game will automatically adjust to your monitor's resolution.
[*]Issues with not being able to save should be fixed.
[*]Controller recognition! The game should be able to recognize your controller input automatically now.
[/list]

We're still working on these main issues:
[list]
[*]Crashing at certain points
[*]Screen going black at certain points
[/list]

Our devs are also working on other issues that have been reported, but please keep reporting your issues and specs to support@ideafintl.com

As always, thanks for your patience and support!
